hooks.name: Auto-Fix Commands on Save
hooks.description: Automatically runs enhanced-auto-fixer and rebuilds when command files are saved

action.command: powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ".\scripts\dev-tools\auto-fixer.ps1" -Verbose 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm run build --silent 2>&1 | Out-Null; Write-Host "✅ Auto-fixed and rebuilt!" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "❌ Auto-fix failed" -ForegroundColor Red }
